- It mentions Sentinel checkpoints as a recovery option if you change your mind later.
- `.sentinel/` itself holds live state (db, event log, scan cache, all modified today) — I already excluded it from the clean regardless.

If you want me to proceed, run `sentinel allow --last --once` yourself (or confirm here and I'll run it), and I'll retry the exact same `git clean -fd -e .sentinel` command.
